items.description: Apple has made the unprecedented decision to hike the prices of all its current computers and tablets with some entry-level model prices up as much as $500.
items.tldr: Appleは、全ての現行コンピュータとタブレットの価格を引き上げ、エントリーモデルでは最大500ドルの値上げを行い、最も安いMacBook Proは400ドル上昇して1,999ドルになった。

items.title: The Nintendo Switch 2 Led US Physical Games to a YoY Spending Increase for the First Time in 17 Years
items.description: Sales for physical video game releases have been declining for over a decade now due to the rise in digital game sales, and with the revelation that GTA 6 will arrive as a code in a box in November for the few players who still head to brick-and-mortar retail stores to buy their games, physical sale
items.tldr: TL;DR: 任天堂のSwitch 2の登場により、米国のフィジカルゲームの売上が17年ぶりに前年比で増加した。デジタルゲームの普及が進む中、GTA 6の発売がフィジカル販売を刺激した。

items.title: Apple Announces Massive Price Increases Across The Board, With Up To $1,300 Premium Being Charged As The Memory Crisis Claims The Trillion-Dollar Giant
items.description: CEO Tim Cook had already warned that memory prices had become unsustainable, which only meant that Apple was running on borrowed time in keeping the MSRP of its products as low as possible. Unfortunately, the Cupertino firm has thrown in the towel and has announced price bumps across its entire prod
items.tldr: Appleは、メモリ価格の高騰を受けて、全製品の価格を最大1,300ドル引き上げることを発表しました。CEOのティム・クックは、持続不可能なメモリ価格について警告していました。

items.title: Anthropic claims that China's Alibaba used 25,000 fake accounts and 28.8 million exchanges to illicitly 'distill' its Claude model — violations occurred from April to June 2026
items.description: AI tech giant Alibaba, often considered as the Amazon of China, is being accused by Anthropic for using Claude to train its AI models. The American AI startup claimed that it traced over 25,000 accounts to operators that were affiliated with Alibaba and Alibaba Qwen.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Anthropicは、中国のAI大手Alibabaが25,000の偽アカウントと2880万の取引を使用してClaudeモデルを不正に「蒸留」したと主張している。

items.title: The Ultimate Summer Sale Pairing: Steam Sale Meets GeForce NOW Discounts
items.description: Summer savings are heating up. From the Steam Summer Sale to GeForce NOW membership discounts, this week’s GFN Thursday delivers double the deals and more ways to get the most value from cloud gaming. Plus, Dark Scrolls joins the growing Devolver lineup, alongside Square Enix’s The Adventures of Ell
items.tldr: 今週のGFN Thursdayでは、SteamサマーセールとGeForce NOWのメンバーシップ割引が組み合わさり、クラウドゲーミングの価値を最大化するための特別なセールが提供されます。さらに、ダークスクロールズがDevolverのラインナップに加わり、スクウェア・エニックスの「エルの冒険」も登場します。

items.title: Enshrouded Locks October 15 1.0 Launch for PC and PS5, yet Xbox Players Must Wait Until Spring 2027
items.description: Today, independent German developer Keen Games announced the release date of Enshrouded 1.0. The game will be released on October 15 for PC and PlayStation 5, but the Xbox version has been delayed to next Spring. Jan Jöckel, CEO of Keen Games, said in a statement: Our team worked tirelessly to launc
items.tldr: 独立系開発者Keen Gamesは、ゲーム「Enshrouded」の1.0版をPCとPS5向けに10月15日に発売することを発表したが、Xbox版は2027年春まで延期される。

items.title: AMD Slashes 9600X And 7600X Below $180 And $150 As AM5 Builds Get Dramatically Cheaper to Enter
items.description: More processors are getting a discount on this Prime Day deal, and you shouldn't miss these Ryzen CPUs if you want to build a powerful gaming PC on a budget. AMD Ryzen 5 9600X Drops to Just $179 While Ryzen 5 7600X is Now Down to $146 on Amazon There are some excellent deals on Amazon at the moment,
items.tldr: AMDは、Ryzen 5 9600Xを179ドル、Ryzen 5 7600Xを146ドルに値下げし、AM5ビルドのコストが大幅に下がっています。これにより、予算内で強力なゲーミングPCを構築する絶好の機会となっています。

items.title: Today only, you can snag a 37-inch 4K Samsung monitor for just $249 – B&H offers up a big productivity screen for 50% off in a one-day deal
items.description: B&H is selling a 37-inch 4K Samsung monitor for half off, or just $249, today only.
items.tldr: B&Hが37インチの4K Samsungモニターを50%オフの249ドルで販売中、これは今日限りの特別オファーです。

items.title: Qualcomm plans China-specific data center chips — new Dragonfly lineup will include nerfed AI accelerators that comply with export thresholds
items.description: Qualcomm has announced that it will bring all four of its Dragonfly data center product lines to China.
items.tldr: Qualcommは、中国向けにすべてのDragonflyデータセンター製品ラインを展開する計画を発表し、輸出基準に準拠した制限付きのAIアクセラレーターを含む。

items.title: ASUS Quietly Rolls Out New BIOS Patch That Restores TSME On Consumer Ryzen Chips
items.description: Vendors have started releasing new BIOS updates that restores the TSME feature on consumer Ryzen CPUs. ASUS Releases ComboAM5 P1 1.3.0.1b Patch A to Restore TSME Feature on Non-PRO Ryzen CPUs After AMD Promised to Reinstate it A week ago, users complained that their Ryzen CPUs were no longer showing
items.tldr: ASUSが新しいBIOSパッチComboAM5 P1 1.3.0.1bをリリースし、AMDが約1週間前に約束した通り、消費者向けRyzen CPUのTSME機能を復元しました。

items.title: HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wireless Headset Review: 80 hours and under $100
items.description: The HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wireless is an over-ear wireless gaming headset with 50mm dynamic drivers, a flip-to-mute boom mic, and up to 80 hours of battery life — all for under $100.
items.tldr: HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wirelessは、50mmダイナミックドライバーとフリップトゥミュートのブームマイクを搭載し、80時間のバッテリー寿命を持ちながら、価格は100ドル未満のオーバーイヤー無線ゲーミングヘッドセットです。

items.title: Micron inks long-term supply agreements worth $100 billion — says it has no idea when RAM crisis will end
items.description: Micron has signed 16 LTAs with various customers to supply DRAM and NAND worth $100 billion.
items.tldr: Micronは、DRAMとNANDの供給に関する16件の長期供給契約（LTA）を締結し、その総額は1000億ドルに達したが、RAMの供給危機がいつ終わるかは不明であると述べている。

items.title: Valve’s Steam Machine Could Have Launched Near $718, but the Component Crisis Pushed It to $1049 Instead
items.description: Valve's reveal that the Steam Machine would be priced at $1049 for the base edition (512 GB with no controller) and up to $1428 for the 2TB edition with a Steam Controller rocked most consumers who were looking forward to buying one at a much lower price. The Steam company made it crystal clear that
items.tldr: ValveのSteam Machineは、当初718ドルでの発売が見込まれていたが、部品不足の影響で価格が1049ドルに引き上げられたことが明らかになった。

items.title: Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus Drops To Just $264 On Amazon
items.description: One of the fastest gaming and productivity chip is now under $300, making it a perfect choice for enthusiasts. Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus Gets a $35 Discount on Amazon, Making it the Cheapest 24-Core CPU on the Market You don't see great CPU deals every day, but thanks to the Prime Day deals, some
items.tldr: Intel Core Ultra 7 270K PlusがAmazonで$264に値下げされ、24コアCPUとして最安値となり、ゲーミングや生産性向上を求めるエンスージアストに最適な選択肢となっています。

items.title: Steam Machines will only come with one 16GB stick of RAM — company may change this to two 8GB sticks in the future, but the first batch of consoles is limited to single-channel memory
items.description: Valve confirmed to Gamers Nexus that the first batch of Steam Machines will only have one 16GB RAM stick. This would have a negative effect on the console's performance, but the company likely did this to keep its price as low as possible, or because it's the only available option left for the compa
items.tldr: Valveは、最初のバッチのSteam Machinesが1本の16GB RAMスティックのみを搭載することを確認し、これがパフォーマンスに悪影響を及ぼす可能性があるとしています。将来的には2本の8GBスティックに変更する可能性もありますが、価格を抑えるための措置かもしれません。

items.title: Valve Is “Irresponsible” To Force AI Disclosures on Steam, Epic CEO Says, While Unreal Engine 6 Doubles Down on AI
items.description: In the past few months, video game publishers and developers have been going all in on generative AI with the justification that it speeds up and improves development. In the attempt to help gamers make informed choices about their purchases, Valve has started enforcing AI disclosures on Steam, whic
items.tldr: ValveがSteamでAIの開示を強制するのは「無責任」とEpicのCEOが批判する一方で、Unreal Engine 6はAIにさらに注力している。

items.title: IBM Outlines Sub-1nm Nanostack Transistor Technology: Building the Next Gen By Going Up
items.description: Today IBM is unveiling their nanostack transistor architecture. Meant to drive chip construction in the sub-1nm era in the 2030s, nanostack aims for building better and smaller chips by building them taller via wafer stacking The post IBM Outlines Sub-1nm Nanostack Transistor Technology: Building th
items.tldr: IBMがナノスタックトランジスタアーキテクチャを発表し、2030年代のサブ1nm時代に向けて、ウエハーススタッキングによるより小型で高性能なチップの構築を目指しています。

items.title: Chrome Ad Blocker with 10M+ Installs Found with Dormant Script Injection Capability
items.description: An analysis of a popular Google Chrome ad block extension for YouTube has uncovered the ability to execute arbitrary JavaScript code. According to Island, the extension, named Adblock for YouTube (ID: cmedhionkhpnakcndndgjdbohmhepckk), has more than 10 million installs and carries a Featured badge o
items.tldr: 人気のGoogle Chrome拡張機能「Adblock for YouTube」が、任意のJavaScriptコードを実行できるスクリプト注入機能を持っていることが発覚し、10百万以上のインストールがある。

items.title: The Four Elevations of Effective Fraud Prevention
items.description: Fraudsters don't attack just one transaction. They target accounts, platforms, and entire ecosystems. IPQS explains the four elevations of fraud prevention and why broader visibility improves fraud detection. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: IPQSは、詐欺防止のための4つのレベルを解説し、広範な可視性が詐欺検出を向上させる理由を説明しています。詐欺師は単一の取引ではなく、アカウントやプラットフォーム、エコシステム全体を標的にします。

items.title: ThreatsDay Bulletin: Smart TV Proxyware, 24-Year curl Bug, AI Crime Forums + 13 More Stories
items.description: It’s dumb out there again. This week has the usual smell of prod on fire and nobody wanting to admit who left the door open — old creds still working, trusted apps doing sketchy crap, browser tricks jumping the fence, and “normal” workflows turning into phishing pipes because apparently email was no
items.tldr: TL;DR: 今週のThreatsDay Bulletinでは、スマートTVのプロキシウェア、24年続いたcurlのバグ、AI犯罪フォーラムなど、サイバーセキュリティの脅威に関する最新情報が報告されています。

items.title: Webinar: Why account takeovers remain one of the hardest threats to stop
items.description: Account takeover attacks continue to challenge security teams because attackers often operate through legitimate accounts and trusted services. This webinar explores how behavioral AI can help organizations identify compromised accounts faster and automate response workflows. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: アカウント乗っ取り攻撃は、攻撃者が正当なアカウントや信頼できるサービスを利用するため、セキュリティチームにとって依然として難しい脅威であり、ウェビナーでは行動AIがどのように侵害されたアカウントの特定と対応ワークフローの自動化を支援できるかを探ります。

items.title: Interesting Paper Exploring Prompt Injection
items.description: This is a fascinating explotation of how LLMs fall for prompt injection attacks. It turns out that they learn to recognize the style of text in different role/instruction blocks, and not just the tags. Their conclusion: Role tags were a formatting trick that became the security architecture and the
items.tldr: TL;DR: LLMはプロンプトインジェクション攻撃に対して脆弱であり、役割や指示ブロック内のテキストスタイルを認識することを学習するため、役割タグはセキュリティアーキテクチャのフォーマット手法に過ぎないという結論に至った。

items.title: Surviving the Mythos Era: Richard Bejtlich on the Case for NDR
items.description: Despite the abundance of telemetry at analysts’ disposal, many security operations teams struggle to answer a few basic questions during incident investigation: What happened? What evidence do we have? How do we know we’re seeing it all, in context? Answering these questions requires teams to go bey
items.tldr: TL;DR: セキュリティオペレーションチームは、インシデント調査中に基本的な質問に答えるのに苦労しており、NDR（Network Detection and Response）の重要性が強調されている。

items.title: Europe Evolves Into Ransomware's Favorite Region
items.description: After a global lull, ransomware gangs are setting sights on a rich new arena: attacking EU organizations and their suppliers.
items.tldr: TL;DR: ランサムウェアギャングが世界的な沈静化を経て、EUの組織やそのサプライヤーを標的にする新たな攻撃を強化している。

items.title: New Gaslight macOS Malware Uses Prompt Injection to Disrupt AI-Assisted Analysis
items.description: A previously undocumented Rust-based macOS implant and information stealer has been found to embed a prompt injection payload designed to trick a malware analyst's artificial intelligence (AI) tools and trick it into aborting or refusing an analysis of the artifact. The malware has been codenamed Ga
items.tldr: 新たに発見されたRustベースのmacOSマルウェア「Gaslight」は、プロンプトインジェクションを利用してAI支援の分析を妨害する仕組みを持っており、マルウェアアナリストのAIツールを欺いて分析を中断させることが目的です。

items.title: New Mistic Backdoor Linked to KongTuke in ClickFix and ModeloRAT Campaigns
items.description: A new, stealthy backdoor named Mistic has been deployed as part of suspected financially motivated attacks aimed at multiple organizations spanning insurance, education, IT, and professional services sectors since April 2026. According to Symantec and Carbon Black's Threat Hunter Team, the backdoor,
items.tldr: 新たに発見されたバックドア「Mistic」は、2026年4月以来、保険、教育、IT、プロフェッショナルサービスなどの複数の組織を狙った金銭的動機に基づく攻撃の一環として展開されている。

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Zero-Day CVE-2026-20245 Exploited to Gain Root Access
items.description: An unknown threat actor exploited a recently disclosed high-severity security flaw impacting Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN as a zero-day at least two months before it was publicly disclosed, according to new findings from Google-owned Mandiant. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-20245 (CVSS score: 7.8),
items.tldr: Cisco Catalyst SD-WANのゼロデイ脆弱性CVE-2026-20245が、公開前の少なくとも2ヶ月間にわたり悪用され、ルートアクセスを取得されたことがMandiantの調査で明らかになった。

items.title: Google releases new privacy controls for activity history, personalization
items.description: Google is rolling out new privacy controls for Search services and Google Play, giving you more control over saved history and personalized recommendations. [...]
items.tldr: Googleが検索サービスとGoogle Play向けに新しいプライバシーコントロールを導入し、保存された履歴やパーソナライズされた推奨の管理を強化しました。

items.title: DraftKings hacker 'Snoopy' sentenced to 18 months in prison
items.description: A 21-year-old using the alias "Snoopy" was sentenced to 18 months in prison for his role in hacking DraftKings accounts in the November 2022 cyberattack. [...]
items.tldr: 21歳の「Snoopy」というハンドルネームのハッカーが、2022年11月のDraftKingsアカウントハッキングに関与したとして18ヶ月の懲役刑を宣告された。

items.title: Mandiant reveals how Cisco SD-WAN zero-day attacks gained root access
items.description: New details have been revealed on how hackers exploited a Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-20245 in zero-day attacks to create rogue root accounts on targeted devices. [...]
items.tldr: Mandiantは、ハッカーがCVE-2026-20245として追跡されるCisco Catalyst SD-WANの脆弱性を悪用し、標的デバイス上に不正なrootアカウントを作成した方法の詳細を明らかにしました。

items.title: Attackers Hit Cisco SD-WAN Flaw 2 Months Before Disclosure
items.description: Researchers believe rogue peering was used to connect to the victim's SD-WAN devices to gain admin privileges and root-level access.
items.tldr: 攻撃者は、開示の2ヶ月前にCiscoのSD-WANの脆弱性を利用し、悪意のあるピアリングを通じて被害者のSD-WANデバイスに接続し、管理者権限とルートレベルのアクセスを取得したと研究者は考えています。

items.title: Malicious Edge extension abuses Native Messaging as bridge to malware
items.description: A malicious Microsoft Edge extension dubbed 'Edgecution' has been used in a ransomware attack to escape the browser sandbox and deploy a Python-based backdoor. [...]
items.tldr: 悪意のあるMicrosoft Edge拡張機能「Edgecution」が、ランサムウェア攻撃に利用され、ブラウザのサンドボックスを回避してPythonベースのバックドアを展開した。

items.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Faces Surge in Cyber Threats
items.description: Persistent cybercrime, social engineering, and infrastructure threats continue to plague the FIFA 2026 World Cup across the US, Canada, and Mexico.
items.tldr: 2026年FIFAワールドカップは、米国、カナダ、メキシコでのサイバー犯罪、ソーシャルエンジニアリング、インフラ脅威の増加に直面している。

items.title: Do CISOs Need a Code of Ethics?
items.description: Dark Reading Confidential Episode 19: Kickbacks, no-show jobs, "dirty" VCs, and shelf ware — industry expert Robert "RSnake" Hansen explains why he thinks its time for a CISO code of ethics to ensure cybersecurity bosses aren't engaged in self-dealing that could risk enterprise,
items.tldr: CISOに倫理規定が必要かという議論があり、業界の専門家ロバート・ハンセンは、サイバーセキュリティの責任者が自己利益を追求することを防ぐために倫理規定の導入を提唱しています。

items.title: CISA Warns Critical Lantronix EDS5000 Flaw Is Being Actively Exploited
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday warned of active exploitation of a critical security flaw impacting Lantronix EDS5000 Series devices, urging Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to apply the fixes by June 26, 2026. The vulnerability in questio
items.tldr: CISAは、Lantronix EDS5000シリーズデバイスに影響を与える重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が積極的に悪用されていると警告し、連邦政府機関に2026年6月26日までに修正を適用するよう促しています。

items.title: More Malicious OpenClaw Skills Threaten AI Supply Chain
items.description: OpenClaw removed five packages from its ClawHub skills marketplace that bypassed security checks even though they included infostealers and other threats.
items.tldr: TL;DR: OpenClawは、セキュリティチェックを回避していたインフォステーラーなどの脅威を含む5つのパッケージをClawHubスキルマーケットプレイスから削除しました。

items.title: Amadey and StealC Malware Network Disrupted, 27M Stolen Credentials Recovered
items.description: A coordinated law enforcement operation, in partnership with private sector companies, including Bitdefender, Bitsight, ESET, and Microsoft, has resulted in the takedown of criminal infrastructure powering Amadey and StealC. "The main common goal was to disrupt the 'assembly lines' cybercriminals us
items.tldr: 法執行機関とBitdefender、ESET、Microsoftなどの民間企業が協力し、AmadeyおよびStealCマルウェアネットワークを解体し、2700万件の盗まれた認証情報を回収しました。
